title: A 3D-printed portable device for field deployment of living biosensors
author: Movizzo, Ruder, et al.

steps.title: Create CAD designs
steps.instruction: Design the housing, plunger, and lever‑actuated machine using Autodesk® Inventor Professional 2018, labeling all required features for 3D printing.

steps.title: 3D print components
steps.instruction: Print the housing, plunger, and lever‑actuated machine with Z‑ABS material on a Zortrax® M200 3D printer.

steps.title: Acetone vapor post‑treatment
steps.instruction: Place the printed housing and plunger in an acetone vapor bath for 1 hour to improve surface finish and seal integrity.

steps.title: Assemble bioassay device
steps.instruction: Insert the plunger into the housing to create the two‑stage press‑fit seal, then attach the assembled device to a 14 mL culture tube, forming a watertight seal between the housing and the tube.

steps.title: Prepare lever‑actuated machine
steps.instruction: Print the lever‑actuated machine (designed in step 1) with Z‑ABS on the Zortrax® M200; this machine will be used to break the housing cutout and release the living biosensor into the sample tube.
